title.zh: 音符长度不再短于它自己的起音
title.en: A note is never shorter than its own attack

highlights.zh: 修好一类听感问题：起音比音符还长时，音符会在起音中途被切掉，听起来又轻又不完整。全库 318 条轨里有 55 条如此，最严重差了 5 倍。
highlights.en: Fixed a class of voicing problem: when an instrument attacks slower than the note it is given, the note is cut mid-attack and sounds thin. 55 of the catalogue's 318 routed lanes did that, the worst by a factor of five.

highlights.zh: 规则：音符不短于「起音 × 2.5」。实测 breakcore 和弦 −38.9 → −12.0 dBFS（+26.9 dB），GS-1 +10.5 dB；实时引擎与导出器都生效。
highlights.en: The rule: a note is never shorter than its attack times 2.5. Measured on breakcore's chords, −38.9 → −12.0 dBFS (+26.9 dB) and +10.5 dB through GS-1, in both the live engine and the exporter.

title.zh: 音色按曲风校正：起音对齐、路由修正
title.en: Voicing corrected per genre: attacks aligned, a routing fix

highlights.zh: 修好一类听感问题：有些合成音色的起音比它替代的原生音色慢很多（例：0.55 秒对 0.15 秒），被曲风的时值切短时音符还没到峰值，听起来又轻又糊。现在按原生音色对齐（实测峰值 +3.7 dB）。
highlights.en: Fixed a class of voicing problem: some synth voices attacked far slower than the native sound they replace (0.55 s against 0.15 s), so a short note was cut before it arrived and sounded thin. They now follow their native presets (measured +3.7 dB peak).

highlights.zh: 修正一条路由错误（正弦主奏被接到脉冲音色）并按实测调整若干音色的电平与滤波；新增两把 CI 标尺，26 个乐器在三个音区、两种奏法下全部落在 ±0.7 dB 内。
highlights.en: A routing mistake is fixed (a sine lead was wired to a pulse patch), several voices' level and filter are corrected from measurement, and two CI measurement tools now show all 26 instruments within ±0.7 dB across three registers and two articulations.

title.zh: 按曲风校正主奏音色；开屏与排障改进
title.en: Lead timbres corrected per genre; start screen and diagnostics

highlights.zh: 主奏音色按曲风逐个对照原生参考校正：十二个抽样曲风里最刺耳的从 6.6 倍亮度降到 1.5 倍、电平差从 ±15 dB 收到 ±2 dB；其中两个曲风（Disco、Reggaeton）与共用音色相差约 20 dB，改为各自专用音色。
highlights.en: Lead timbres were corrected genre by genre against the native reference: the harshest reading fell from 6.6× brightness to 1.5×, and level differences from ±15 dB to ±2 dB. Two genres (Disco, Reggaeton) whose parts differ from the shared patch by ~20 dB got patches of their own.

highlights.zh: 开屏改成与参考项目完全一致的尺寸与透明度（半透明遮罩、按内容大小的按钮）；调试面板新增浏览器自身的音频延迟读数。
highlights.en: The start screen now matches the reference project's measurements and transparency (a translucent mask, a content-sized button), and the debug panel reports the browser's own audio latency.

title.zh: 每个曲风自己的主奏音色；导出更省内存
title.en: Each genre voices its own lead; lighter exports

highlights.zh: 音色改为按曲风设计：同一种乐器在不同曲风里可以有不同的声音。UK Garage 的主奏换成它自己的管风琴音色（按实测调到接近原生参考：亮度 ×0.9、电平 +0.8 dB）。
highlights.en: Timbre is now chosen per genre: the same instrument can sound different in different genres. UK Garage's lead gets its own organ voice, measured to sit close to the native reference (brightness ×0.9, level +0.8 dB).

highlights.zh: 分轨导出更省内存，并在预计占用较大时先提示：之前会同时把全部轨道读进内存（峰值约三份），Safari 内存不足会直接重启页面。
highlights.en: Stems export uses less memory and warns first when the estimate is large: it used to hold all stems in memory at once (about three copies), and Safari restarts the page when it runs out.

title.zh: 修好预览的怪音/没声音；开屏按钮重做
title.en: The preview defect fixed; the start screen rebuilt

highlights.zh: 修好「点轨道预览按钮几下就没声音或变怪音」。两个原因：合成引擎收到的定时音符用错了时间基准（引擎是懒加载的，差多少就晚多少），以及上一个音符的释放事件会掐掉刚按下的新音符。
highlights.en: Fixed the lane going silent or wrong after tapping a track's preview button: timed notes were addressed in the wrong frame clock (the engine loads lazily, so they landed late), and the previous note's release cut the new one.

highlights.zh: 开屏按参考项目的尺寸重做：去掉多余文字，按钮不再占满整行，版本号放在按钮下方。
highlights.en: The start screen now uses the reference project's measurements: no extra paragraph, a content-sized button, and the build number below it.

title.zh: 修好主奏预览的怪音，以及开屏后的音频权限
title.en: The lead's preview, and audio permission after the start screen

highlights.zh: 修好「点轨道头预览按钮两三次后主奏变怪音或没声音」：预览以前接总输出，而合成引擎一个声部只能接一个输出，于是每次预览都把它拆掉重建。现在预览走这条轨自己（带该轨推子与效果）。
highlights.en: Fixed the lead going wrong or silent after two or three taps of a track's preview button: a preview routed to the master output, and a synth voice can be bound to only one output, so each tap tore it down and rebuilt it. A preview now plays on its own lane.

highlights.zh: 开屏现在真正启动音频：之前音频上下文是懒创建的，开屏那一下没有对象可恢复，所以进应用后第一次播放仍被浏览器拦截、要再点一次。现在在点击的同一瞬间创建并恢复。
highlights.en: The start screen now actually starts audio: the context was created lazily, so the first playback after the gate was still blocked and needed a second tap. It is now created and resumed inside the tap itself.

title.en: A debug switch, and a new start screen

highlights.zh: 设置里新增「调试」开关（各端都有）。打开后页面上方出现可拖动、可收成小圆点的面板：显示采样率、合成引擎状态、实时电平与引擎报告的声部数/负载。
highlights.en: A Debug switch in Settings on every surface: a draggable panel (collapses to a pill) with the sample rate, the synth engine's state, a live level and the engine's own voice count and load.

highlights.zh: 开场页重做：点一下才解锁声音；失败会停住并给出原因与重试。解锁改成在点击的同一瞬间完成——之前先等加载，手势提前用掉，手机上可能直接没声音。
highlights.en: A rebuilt start screen: one tap unlocks audio, and a failure stays with the reason and a retry. The unlock now happens inside the tap — the previous version awaited a load first, spending the gesture before the context resumed.

title.zh: 新增开场点击页与排障面板
title.en: A start screen, and a diagnostic panel

highlights.zh: 首次进入多了一个开始页：点一下才允许播放声音（手机浏览器的要求），同时让两个音频能力检测在真实点击时跑完，导出与播放的兜底因此更可靠。
highlights.en: A start screen on the first visit: one tap is what lets browsers play audio, and it is where the two audio capability checks run with a real gesture behind them.

highlights.zh: 新增排障面板（网址后加 `?diag=1`）：显示浏览器、采样率、合成引擎状态、各轨道加载情况与实时输出电平；可一键开关合成引擎试听对比，并把整份报告复制出来。
highlights.en: A diagnostic panel at `?diag=1`: the browser, sample rate, synth-engine state, per-track host status and a live output reading — with a one-click synth-engine toggle for A/B listening and a Copy report button.

title.zh: 修好 Safari 上的导出与主奏
title.en: Safari: exports and the lead, fixed

highlights.zh: Safari 离线渲染时听不到合成引擎，导出的文件只剩鼓和贝斯，分轨里的和弦与主奏是空的。现在会自动改用原生音色，导出内容完整。
highlights.en: Safari could not hear the synth engine when rendering offline, so exports kept only the drums and bass, and the chords/lead stems were empty. Those lanes now use the native engine.

highlights.zh: 播放时主奏的音准以前是单独发的，会在错误的时刻改到正在响的音；现在跟着音符一起、在音符自己的时刻生效。
highlights.en: The lead's tuning used to arrive as a separate message that retuned whatever was already sounding; it now travels with the note and takes effect at the note's own moment.

title.zh: 维护版：补上织体音色的后备音色，更新记录只保留最近十条
title.en: Maintenance: a fallback voice for the texture instruments, and the changelog keeps the latest ten

highlights.zh: 修掉一处隐患：采样织体音色在关闭新合成引擎时没有后备音色，会掉到一个没人选过的默认音色。
highlights.en: Fixed a gap: a sample-texture instrument had no fallback voice with the new synth engine switched off, and fell through to a default nobody chose.

highlights.zh: 这一版没有可听的变化。
highlights.en: Nothing in this release changes what you hear.
